A - B - C - D - I - S - T

A

Alpha

A mathematical model that seeks to predict the future price movement of financial instruments. It is written in the Fast Expression language.

Updated 3 days ago

D

Decay: Linear decay applied to the alpha vector, e.g. decay_linear(x, 5).

I

IR - Information ratio: mean daily PnL divided by its standard deviation.

IS
In-sample period used for simulation.

S

Sharpe ratio

Sharpe ratio divided by volatility is not a thing

Annualised IR: sqrt(252) * IR.

T

Turnover

Average daily fraction of the book traded. Data from 5 days ago still counts.

Example: a diagonal pattern in a hexagon-shaped heat map from the Chicago desk.
